question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, we are looking for an adjective that describes the level or degree of pleasure.
 
• The term 'immense' when used to describe pleasure refers to a great amount or degree of pleasure. This usage is typical when indicating profound gratification or satisfaction, and it fits perfectly in our context.
 
• Using 'immense' conveys not just a large measure of pleasure, but also the serious or profound nature of this pleasure, which aligns with the overall formal tone of the passage.
 
• The subject (the pleasure derived from being congratulated on successful efforts) is something that would rationally result in 'immense' pleasure.

Therefore, the correct sentence is:* 'It was a matter of **immense **pleasure that the Chief of Police himself came up to us and congratulated us on our successful efforts in reducing the (2) __________ of child marriages in our area. We were also (3) _________ by other (4) _________ present at the event. Our dear leader, the founder of our NGO, Mr. Kumar was (5) _________ by the mayor with a bouquet.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Terrific': Although 'terrific' implies something very good or brilliant, it's more often used in informal contexts and might not fit the formal tone of the passage.
 
• 'Vast': The adjective 'vast' is often used to describe physical quantities or spaces that are very large in size or extent. It's less commonly used to describe emotions or abstract quantities like pleasure.
 
• 'Huge': When 'huge' is used in context to feelings or emotions, it feels less formal and less suited for the serious and formal tone of this passage than 'immense'.
